verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that vLLM has a command line: `vllm serve` starts the OpenAI-compatible server and accepts flags such as --trust-remote-code and --enable-offline-docs. However, no cited item documents CLI flags for GPU offload or for setting context length. A CLI with unrelated flags is only adjacent support, so this applicable axis has no evidence of the specific capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
